# Genar Trias Ortiz

**Software engineer. I design the abstractions and build the products, and I keep both simple enough to change.**

> Software as a creative craft

What I care about is building things: finding the right abstraction for a
problem and turning it into a software product people actually use.

A good abstraction makes the rest of the system obvious. A bad one makes every
change expensive. Most of my work is the patient part in between: modelling
the domain, keeping interfaces small, and letting tests and continuous delivery
keep the design honest as the product grows.

Tools change; I use whatever gets the job done, from automation to AI. What
keeps me hooked is the creative side of software development, and every part
of the craft around it.

Free software supporter, happy vim user and automation addict.

## What I work on

- Software design & abstractions
- Product engineering
- Automation
- Self-hosting & free software

## Things I build

### Products

- **[Sunflare](https://sunflare.app)**: Website, client galleries and bookings for photographers, set up in minutes.
- **[deplayer](https://deplayer.app)**: Local-first media player in the browser, across your files, Subsonic, WebTorrent and more.
- **[SlideTime](https://slidetime.app)**: Local-first markdown presentations, free and interactive.
- **[REFSTASH](https://refstash.app)**: A stash for UI references, to collect and organise design inspiration.
- **[Mythgrow](https://mythgrow.site)**: A virtual creature game with AI companions that hatch from eggs.
- **[Age of Slop](https://ageofslop.app)**: Post-apocalyptic RTS in the browser, fully local, with every unit and building made procedurally.

### Open source

- **[OpenEnroth for PS Vita](https://github.com/gtrias/OpenEnroth/releases/tag/vita-v0.1)**: Native PS Vita port of OpenEnroth, so Might and Magic VII runs on the Vita.
- **[tmuxgotchi](https://github.com/gtrias/tmuxgotchi)**: Tamagotchi-style TUI for keeping an eye on agent sessions in tmux.
- **[dev-service-discovery](https://github.com/gtrias/dev-service-discovery)**: Auto-exposes local dev servers over HTTPS with Traefik and Tailscale.

### Writing

- **[Genar | Fika](https://genar.fika.bar)**: Long-form writing on building software, local AI and working as an indie developer.
